result.description:

What you're seeing IS NOT an AI video, it’s an entire fully explorable world.

result.title: This AI Turns Insane Ideas Into 3D Objects
result.description:
This was just a picture… and now it’s a 3D-printable object. 

A new AI model called Tripo 2.0 can take almost any image and turn it into a full 3D model you can export to Blender, Unreal Engine, or a 3D printer.

The possibilities are wild: custom game characters, collectibles, animation assets, product prototypes, or literally anything you can imagine.
